in_english.name: Moktar
in_english.meaning: Conqueror, victorious, triumphant, successful, and prosperous
in_english.long_meaning: Moktar is an Arabic name that means conqueror, victorious, triumphant, successful, and prosperous. It is derived from the root word 'k-t-r' which means to conquer or to overcome. The name Moktar is mentioned in the Quran as a title of praise for those who are successful in their endeavors and who have been granted victory by Allah. In Islamic tradition, Moktar is considered a name of great significance and is often given to children born into families of high social status.
